candidates.statement: Hence, there must exist a direct connection of the $q$-parameter in (12), (14) with the fermion mixing angle.

Then, experimentally one should observe the tendency of merging $\lambda(\pi)$ and $\lambda(K)$ at large enough mean momenta, i.e., $\lambda^{\rm as}(\pi)=\lambda^{\rm as}(K)$.
